City Clerk

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS
Citizens wishing to address the City Council and Successor Agency on any item on the Closed Session agenda
may do so at this time.  Please complete a speaker's card and give it to the City Clerk /Secretary prior to
commencement of the City Council/ Successor Agency meetings. Please limit your remarks to three (3) minutes.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

1.  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957, the City Council will consider personnel
  matters related to public employee discipline/ dismissal/release - One (1) case.
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

6:00 P.M. - CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  SCHEDULED MATTERS

1.  City Council Reorganization
  The City Council will consider extending current appointment of the Mayor and
  the Mayor Pro Tempore to January 2025 to coincide with the Municipal
  election of November 2024.
  Attachments:  Staff Report

ADJOURNMENT

minutes_text:
AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
6:30 P.M. CLOSED SESSION

CALL TO ORDER Mayor Argumedo called meeting to order at 6:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS There were no individuals wishing to address the City Council on any items on the agenda.  

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION City Council recessed to closed session at 6:02 p.m.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION City Council reconvened to Open Session at 6:55 p.m.

ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT City Attorney Tapia reported on Closed Session item #1 - City Council met in a Closed Session and unanimously accepted the resignation of City Manager Edgar Cisneros effective December 6, 2023. The Council expressed gratitude for Cisneros' service and wished him success in his future endeavors.

6:00 P.M. - CITY COUNCIL MEETING

1.. City Council Reorganization There was a consensus among the City Council to move this item to the next City Council meeting.  

SCHEDULED MATTERS

ADJOURNMENT Meeting adjourned at 6:58 p.m.

Written materials distributed to the City Council are available for public inspection immediately following the posting of this agenda (at least 72 hours prior to a regular City Council meetings) in the City Clerk's Office, at Commerce City Hall, 2535 Commerce Way, Commerce, California, and the Central Library, 5655 Jillson Street, Commerce, California.


Meeting facilities are accessible to persons with disabilities. ln compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, notify the Office of the City Clerk at (323) 722-4805 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting.
